mentions.name: allyourwords
mentions.description: A Mac app that listens to the microphone and provides real-time feedback on speaking pace, filler words, and similar aspects of delivery during meetings.
mentions.problem: Speakers tend to get carried away in meetings.
mentions.source_excerpt: a mac app that listens to your microphone and gives feedback on your pace, filler words etc in real time. Built for myself as I tend to get carried away in meetings.
mentions.author: dinferizovic
